title: MasterCatalogSchema
description: Standardized product catalog schema for enriched SKUs

category.description: Top-level product category from standard taxonomy

size.description: Product size clothing size dimensions label etc

dimensions.description: Physical dimensions LxWxH or relevant measure

description.description: Rich SEO-optimized product description min 50 words

seo_tags.description: List of SEO keyword tags for search optimization

supplier_sku.description: Original SKU as provided by the supplier

is_duplicate.description: Whether this product was flagged as a duplicate

duplicate_of.description: SKU of the canonical product if this is a duplicate

language_detected.description: ISO 639-1 language code detected in original listing

quality_score.description: Completeness and confidence score from 0 to 100

flags.description: List of issues warnings or agent decisions for auditability

needs_human_review.description: True if quality_score < 50 requires human-in-the-loop review
